about.seoTitle: About us | Mashawirk delivery in the UAE
about.seoDescription: Learn about Mashawirk: parcel, order and supplies delivery in the UAE with international options.
about.seoKeywords: about Mashawirk, Dubai delivery company, UAE parcel delivery
about.title: About us
about.lead: Mashawirk exists to make delivery clearer and calmer — from the first WhatsApp message to handoff.
about.text: We focus on parcels, orders and supplies across the UAE, with international coordination to Saudi Arabia, Oman and Qatar when needed, and passenger trips as a secondary option.
about.storyText: It started with a simple need: a tidy delivery trip, fast communication, and clear follow-up without friction. Mashawirk serves people, shops and everyday requests the same way — WhatsApp first, then confirm and deliver.
about.missionText: Deliver carefully and keep every trip detail clear from the start: location, timing and service type.
about.valueCareText: We handle parcels and supplies calmly — especially sensitive requests like gifts.
about.valueClearText: Booking and updates happen directly on WhatsApp, without complicated steps.
about.valueCoverageText: Primarily within the UAE, with international requests to Saudi Arabia, Oman and Qatar after review.
about.focusNote: For light goods we provide driver and vehicle only — no loading or unloading workers.
about.baseText: Al Qusais, Dubai — serving trips across the UAE based on availability and coordination.
about.ctaText: Send your request details on WhatsApp and we will confirm delivery with you quickly.
